description: Audio player with play, timeline, elapsed and total time, and 15-second jumps.

howToUse: Pass `duration` in seconds when you know it, so the total shows before the file loads.
The file only downloads when the person presses play (`preload="none"`).
Use `description` for episode, author or date; `artwork` takes a square cover.

keyboard.action: Moves between play, back, timeline and forward.
